name: Rosh Hashanah acoustic

songs.title: I Shall Be Released
songs.chords: Capo 2: G Am Bm C D
songs.lyrics:
(Capo 2 — G shapes; sounding A)

[G]They say ev'rything can be re[Am]placed,
[Bm]Yet ev'ry distance is [Am]not [G]near.
[G]So I remember ev'ry [Am]face
[Bm]Of ev'ry man who put me [Am]here.[G]

[G]I see my light come [Am]shining
[Bm]From the west unto the [D]east.[G]
[G]Any day now, [Am]any day now,
[Bm]I shall be re[D]leased.[G]

[G]They say ev'ry man needs pro[Am]tection,
[Bm]They say ev'ry man must [D]fall.[G]
[G]Yet I swear I see my re[Am]flection
[Bm]Some place so high above this [D]wall.[G]

[G]I see my light come [Am]shining
[Bm]From the west unto the [D]east.[G]
[G]Any day now, [Am]any day now,
[Bm]I shall be re[D]leased.[G]

[G]Well yonder stands a man in this lonely [Am]crowd,
[Bm]A man who swears he's not to [D]blame.[G]
[G]All day long I hear him shout so [Am]loud,
[Bm]Calling out that he's been [D]framed.[G]

[G]I see my light come [Am]shining
[Bm]From the west unto the [D]east.[G]
[G]Any day now, [Am]any day now,
[Bm]I shall be re[D]leased.[G]

songs.title: The Heart of the Matter
songs.chords: D A G Bm Em Asus4 C Am G/B (intro: D–Dsus4 riff)
songs.lyrics:
(No capo — key of D. Intro: D / Dsus4 riff)

[D]I got the call today that I [A]didn't wanna hear
[G]But I knew that it would come
[D]An old, true friend of ours was [A]talkin' on the phone
[G]She said you found someone
[A]And I thought of all the bad luck and the struggles we went through
[G]How I lost me, and you lost you
[A]What are those voices outside love's open door
[G]Make us blow off our contentment
[Asus4]And beg for something [A]more

[D]I'm learning to live with[Em]out you [G]now
[A]But I miss you sometimes
[D]The more I know, the [Em]less I understand
[G]All the things I thought I knew
[A]I'm learning again
[D]I been tryin' to get down
[Bm]To the heart of the matter
[G]But my will gets weak
[A]And my thoughts seem to scatter but I think it's a[D]bout
[Bm]Forgiveness, forgiveness
[G]Even if even if [A]you don't love me any[D]more

[D]Oh these times are so uncertain
There's a [A]yearning undefined
[G]And people filled with rage
[D]We all need a little tenderness
How can [A]love survive
[G]In such a graceless age
[A]The trust and self-assurance
That lead to happiness
[G]They're the very things we kill I guess
[A]Pride and competition cannot fill these empty arms
[G]And the work I put between us
[Asus4]You know it doesn't keep me [A]warm

[D]I'm learning to live with[Em]out you [G]now
[A]But I miss you baby
[D]The more I know, the [Em]less I understand
[G]All the things I thought I'd figured out
[A]I have to learn again
[D]I been tryin' to get down
[Bm]To the heart of the matter
[G]But everything changes
[A]And my friends seem to scatter but I think it's a[D]bout
[Bm]Forgiveness, forgiveness
[G]Even if [A]you don't love me any[D]more

[C]There are people in your life [G/B]who've come and gone
[Am]They'll let you down, you know they'll [G/B]hurt your pride
[C]You better put it all behind you baby, be[G/B]cause life goes on
[A]You keep carrying that anger it'll eat you up inside, baby

[D]I been tryin' to get down
[Bm]To the heart of the matter
[G]But my will gets weak
[A]And my thoughts seem to scatter but I think it's a[D]bout
[Bm]Forgiveness, forgiveness
[G]Even if [A]you don't love me
[D]I been tryin' to get down
[Bm]To the heart of the matter
[G]Because the flesh will get weak
[A]And the ashes will scatter so I'm thinkin' a[D]bout
[Bm]Forgiveness, forgiveness
[G]Even if [A]you don't love me any[D]more
